pages.text: Guardians are strange creatures that may or may not be some sort of flesh-golem creature, similar to Creepers and Shulkers. Unlike those two, probably, these creatures can age and become a stronger specimen at a very old age.

With the mystical Aging Cream, you're able age up a Guardian into an Elder Guardian, making it not only bigger and stronger, but also gives it the knowledge to magically give Mining Fatigue III to nearby non-allied entities similar to yourself.
